payload.text: Etsy Trend Guide: Personalized and Custom Gifts Forecast - Custom birth flower jewelry, acrylic song plaques, and custom embroidered sweatshirts ($28-$65) are top volume drivers. Buyers emphasize fast delivery and durable material.

Shopify Market Research: The Boom in Custom Keepsakes - POD (Print-on-demand) and laser-engraving have low barriers to entry. Differentiating factor is gift-ready packaging and personalization preview tools.
